hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The supported singleton compression permanently commits each deletion when its local final-context ablation passes, but later deletions can change that context and invalidate an earlier deletion certificate. The rejected joint-block mechanism addressed interactions by widening deletion scope and produced 2 wins but worse candidate median, suggesting that interaction handling needs a rollback safety net rather than coarser removals.

causal_change.factor: Lifetime of a terminal deletion's causal acceptance certificate
causal_change.before: A singleton patch deletion becomes permanent as soon as its terminal ablation closes the motivating failures and preserves the precommitted regression obligations in the then-current compressed engine.
causal_change.after: Every passing singleton deletion remains provisional until the fully compressed engine passes one terminal audit against the preserved raw evidence and precommitted obligations; if that audit exposes a regression, the producer restores exact deleted deltas in reverse deletion order, retaining each restoration only when it causally closes the regression, and emits only after the audit is clean or all deletions are restored.
causal_change.why_causal: A deletion can be locally safe yet become harmful after subsequent deletions alter control flow, search behavior, or responsibility for an obligation. Delaying the deletion certificate's finality lets the same trajectory observe those emergent interactions and recover through exact rollback without widening interventions into the unsupported joint-block policy.

hypothesis.expected_effect: The loop should preserve the champion's beneficial singleton pruning while reducing weak median artifacts caused by interacting deletions. Final engines should retain fewer genuinely stale patches but restore patches whose value reappears only in the fully compressed context, improving paired consistency without increasing invalid arms.
hypothesis.falsifier: In the three matched pairs, the hypothesis is falsified if any candidate arm is invalid, candidate wins do not exceed candidate losses, or the candidate median Elo does not exceed the incumbent median Elo.
hypothesis.behavioral_novelty: After several individually justified deletions, the producer can detect that the assembled compressed engine has regressed and selectively reinstate an exact earlier patch whose necessity re-emerged in that new context; the champion permanently loses that patch once its initial deletion test passes.
strengths: Preserves the promoted singleton-ablation mechanism instead of adopting the rejected coarse joint-removal policy.
Uses preserved executable evidence and exact reversible deltas to repair compression-induced regressions.
Bounds recovery to the existing deletion stack and reverse-order causal restoration.
Maintains one continuous engine trajectory with no replicated candidates, agents, samples, or best-of-N selection.
risks: The terminal audit is bounded and may miss strength losses outside its preserved obligations.
Reverse deletion order may restore a sufficient patch before identifying a smaller or older causal restoration.
Nondeterministic engine behavior may trigger unnecessary restoration or conceal a regression.
Additional terminal audit and restoration work may reduce time available for other reasoning inside the single call.

structure.name: Provisional Compression with Terminal Restoration
structure.information_flow: One self-contained producer starts from the champion engine, performs the champion's ordered transactional repair and singleton final-context compression, records deletions as reversible provisional deltas, audits the fully compressed result against preserved evidence, causally restores exact deletions when needed, and emits one complete engine.

calls.role: transactional engine producer with compression rollback
calls.objective: Starting from champion_engine, preserve raw audit evidence and follow the champion's ordered A-B-A-B repair admission process. Record accepted edits as exactly reversible deltas. Perform terminal final-context compression using only singleton patch ablations. Treat every passing deletion as provisional. After all singleton decisions, run one terminal audit of the assembled compressed engine against the preserved motivating failures, legality and UCI obligations, and precommitted regression obligations. If the audit exposes a regression, restore deleted deltas in exact reverse deletion order and retain a restoration only when an executable intervention shows that it closes the regression without worsening those obligations. Stop restoration when the audit is clean or all deletions have been restored, then emit one complete legal UCI engine. Do not create replicated engines, parallel samples, near-identical candidate calls, or best-of-N selection.
